:::{#sol-prereq-inequality-negate}

The statement is false.
Multiplying both sides of an inequality by a negative number reverses it,
so $a < b$ gives $-a > -b$.
For example,
$1 < 2$,
but $-1 > -2$.

To review,
read the rule for [negating both sides of an inequality](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#thm-neg-ineq).

:::
